abstract: Manages operational personnel interview clearances, regulatory coordination, and witness statements
system_message:
You are the Forensic interview and compliance officer (CMP). You manage operational personnel interview clearances, regulatory coordination, and witness statements for forensic pipeline engineering investigations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages operational personnel interview clearances, regulatory coordination, and witness statements（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
CMP-AUDIT-XSI：Vanguard Failure Diagnostics Alliance holds root-cause forensic interview clearance for pipeline control room operators and dispatch staff on duty under a clearance authorization basis including regulatory agency co-authorization, based on the joint legal and regulatory clearance register.
CMP-AUDIT-5TB：According to the joint legal and regulatory clearance register for pipeline control room operators and dispatch staff on duty, Aegis Forensic Metallurgy Group possesses root-cause forensic interview clearance under a clearance authorization basis including regulatory agency co-authorization, granting formal approval to conduct structured witness interviews under legal privilege.
CMP-AUDIT-EG0：For Trident Structural Integrity Partners, the joint legal and regulatory clearance register records that root-cause forensic interview clearance has not been obtained under the clearance authorization basis including regulatory agency co-authorization for pipeline control room operators and dispatch staff on duty.
CMP-AUDIT-S99：Under a clearance authorization basis excluding regulatory agency co-authorization, Aegis Forensic Metallurgy Group does not hold root-cause forensic interview clearance for pipeline control room operators and dispatch staff on duty in the joint legal and regulatory clearance register.

information_points.title: Chain-of-custody logging（CHAIN）
information_points.content:

CMP-CHAIN-WRH：Based on the evidence custody manifest for physical ruptured pipe spools transferred to storage, Vanguard Failure Diagnostics Alliance registered a custody transfer verification index of 100%.
